chain.title: Steps
chain.empty: no steps yet — the effect does nothing
chain.abovePay: above the “Cost” line: runs first, once
chain.belowPay: below the “Cost” line: into the steps
chain.callTitle: Call another effect of the system as a step: it runs here
chain.addArmTitle: Add a step to this branch
chain.payTitle: Cost: the steps above run first. Not enough — the action does not happen, nothing changes.
chain.payHint: not enough — the action does not happen
chain.costTitle: What the effect costs: the chosen effect is called as the first step; not enough — the effect does not happen

editor.propsTitle: folder, tags, icon, name in formulas
editor.descTitle: Text on the sheet. Does not affect calculation
editor.descPlaceholder: what it does — in the words of the rulebook
editor.noteHint: visible only here, not shown to the player
editor.notePlaceholder: for yourself: why it is so, what to check
editor.tagsTitle: Action tags: “everything with a tag” triggers, edits by tag and the tag contract (which inputs must be present)
editor.iconTitle: One symbol on the button and in the list
editor.kindHint: Action steps and edits of a hanging effect do not carry over into each other
editor.grantsHint: While this effect hangs, these hang too.

attach.title: On applying
attach.hint: steps right when the effect is applied

detach.title: On ending
detach.hint: steps at the moment the effect is gone: expired, removed, link broken

whileWhen.title: What it does while hanging
whileWhen.handlerEmpty: no steps — reacts, but does nothing

lifetime.countHint: a number or a formula of the effect inputs
lifetime.endsHint: “At the start of the turn” — as “until the start of the next turn”: shield, dodge.
lifetime.endsTurnEnd: at the end of the turn
lifetime.endsTurnStart: at the start of the turn
lifetime.byHint: A sheet from an input — as “until the start of the next turn of whoever applied it”: the “apply” step fills the input.
lifetime.byHolder: the holder — the one it hangs on

name.title: how the effect is named in buttons, triggers and calls

bond.anchorHint: A hanging effect that lands on the actor by itself — for example “Concentration”. When the anchor is removed, everything this action applied ends (except applications marked “stays”).
bond.one: one — a new action releases the previous one

tab.noneHint: Create the first one or take a ready one from the sample on the right.
tab.pickTitle: Pick an effect on the left
tab.pickHint: An effect is a unit of automation: everything the world does by itself. Checks, field changes, states — and what to call them is up to you.

preview.pickHint: The trial shows what the effect will do: A applies it to B.
preview.whoSub: Two new sheets. You can adjust the numbers — for the trial only, nothing is saved.

whatNext.sub: What the called effect does with the inputs passed to it.
whatNext.missingTitle: There is no such effect in the system
whatNext.missingHint: Choose whom to call in the “Which effect” field.
whatNext.meddlers: Which modifiers change the value along the way
whatNext.none: Nothing: whatever is passed is applied. Resistances and vulnerabilities are rules that modify “{{name}}” by tag.
whatNext.then: Then the called effect does, in order
whatNext.noStepsHint: This effect does nothing to the target yet.

handler.title: Trigger #{{n}}: {{sentence}}
handler.holderTip: The holder is the sheet this trigger hangs on.

ask.summary: question words, what to show, who is asked
ask.question: Question words
ask.questionHint: empty: ask in the words of the event
ask.showHint: none ticked: nothing but the words in the question
